interface.signature: def canConvertString(s: str, t: str, k: int) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: len(s) == len(t) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t have the same length and contain only lowercase English letters.
k is a non-negative integer representing the maximum allowed moves.

postconditions.expression: all((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26 == 0 or (ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26 == (26 - (ord(s[i]) - ord(t[i])) % 26) % 26 for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For each character in s and t, the target character t[i] can be obtained by shifting s[i] by some integer number of times (mod 26), accounting for wrap-around.

postconditions.expression: sum(min((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26, (ord(s[i]) - ord(t[i])) % 26) for i in range(len(s))) <= k
postconditions.description: The sum of the minimal shifts required for each character in s to match t (accounting for both forward and backward shifts) does not exceed k.
